class.name: GameplayEffect
class.brief_description: Resource that changes attributes and grants tags, instantly or over time.
class.description: [code]INSTANT[/code] mutates base values permanently. [code]HAS_DURATION[/code] and [code]INFINITE[/code] aggregate onto current values, grant their tags while active, and can tick periodically. Carries [AttributeModifier]s plus tag requirements that decide whether the effect may apply at all.

members.member: The owner must hold none of these, or the effect is not applied.
The owner must hold every one of these, or the effect is not applied.
How long the effect lasts, in seconds. Only read when [member duration_policy] is [constant HAS_DURATION].
Whether the effect applies once, lasts a set time, or lasts until removed.
What this effect [i]is[/i]. Other effects and abilities match against these - notably [member remove_effects_with_tags].
A periodic effect ticks once the moment it is applied, not only after its first period - a poison that bites at once.

Cues for the presentation layer, fired on every peer: executed for an instant effect and each period tick, added and removed with a duration or infinite one. See [signal AbilitySystemComponent.gameplay_cue].
Tags the owner holds while this effect is active. Reference counted, so two effects granting the same tag both have to end before it goes away.
What this effect does to attributes. Each entry names an attribute, an operation and a magnitude.
Re-application interval in seconds - a damage-over-time tick. [code]0[/code] applies the modifiers once and then leaves them standing.
Applying this effect strips every active effect whose [member effect_tags] match - a cleanse, or a buff that replaces a weaker one.
Whether another application of a stacking effect starts its duration over.
What a stacking effect does when its duration runs out.
The most stacks an aggregate effect holds; 0 is no limit. Applications past the limit still refresh the duration when [member stack_duration_refresh] is on.

What applying this effect again, while it is active on the same target, does. Stacks scale every modifier: an ADD counts once per stack, a MULTIPLY is raised to the stack count, an OVERRIDE is unchanged.

constants.constant: Applied once and gone. Its modifiers change the base value rather than standing as a temporary modifier.
Lasts until something removes it. This is the shape a permanent upgrade or an equipped bonus takes.
Lasts [member duration] seconds, then removes itself.
Every application is its own active effect.
Applications on one target share one active effect and add to its stack count. Unreal's AggregateByTarget.
The whole stack goes when the duration ends.
One stack goes and the duration starts over for the rest - a poison wearing off a dose at a time.
